# Rotaract Club of Coimbatore Unique (RAC Coimbatore Unique)

> Official digital presence of the Rotaract Club of Coimbatore Unique, functioning under Rotary International District 3206 (Rotaract District 3206) in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India.

## Organization Summary
- **Official Name**: Rotaract Club of Coimbatore Unique
- **Common Abbreviations & Alternate Names**: RAC Coimbatore Unique, RAC CBE Unique, CBE Unique, Rotaract Unique, Unique Rotaract Club, Coimbatore Unique
- **Club ID**: 50295
- **Charter Date**: 21 November 2000
- **Charter President**: Rtr. Athma Sivakumar
- **Sponsor Club**: Rotary Club of Thondamuthur
- **Rotary District**: Rotary International District 3206 (RID 3206)
- **Rotaract District**: Rotaract District 3206
- **Headquarters / Location**: Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India (Pin: 641001)
- **Official Website**: https://www.raccoimbatoreunique.in/
- **Official Email**: raccoimbatoreunique3206@gmail.com

## Purpose & Focus Areas
The Rotaract Club of Coimbatore Unique is a community-based youth organization that unites students and young professionals (ages 18–30) to develop professional leadership skills and address community needs through sustainable service projects.

Key avenues of service:
1. **Community Service**: Blood donation drives, health awareness, disaster relief, education for underprivileged children, and environmental sustainability in Coimbatore.
2. **Professional Development**: Career mentoring, leadership training seminars, public speaking forums, and corporate networking.
3. **Club Service & Fellowship**: Team retreats, annual installations, cultural galas, and youth empowerment assemblies.
4. **International Service**: Cross-district twin club initiatives, global humanitarian partnerships, and international understanding projects.

## Leadership & Milestones
- Over 25 years of continuous service excellence since chartering in 2000.
- Produced two Past District Rotaract Representatives (PDRRs) and multiple district council leaders in Rotaract District 3206.
- Regularly recognized with District Best Club Awards and Presidential Citations.
